meta.name: options
meta.description: Compare feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommend a path with costs, constraints and evidence. Use for an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比多个可行方案的成本与约束,给出推荐路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在动手写代码前先选定一套架构或交付方案
copy.tagline_en: Compare feasible approaches by cost and constraints, then recommend a path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must settle on an architecture or delivery approach before building

howto.what: 针对客户问题对比若干可行方案,给出带成本、约束与证据的推荐路径。用于架构或交付决策,不涉及具体实现。
howto.when: 当你需要做架构选型或交付决策(而不是写代码实现)时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则直接沿用它当前已净化的信息包与范围。

say.text: 帮我对比三种可行方案,给出成本、约束和推荐路径。
say.note: 会按方法参考逐项比较并给出推荐。

say.text: 把这个交付决策拆成几种方案,列出各自成本和限制。
say.note: 产出各方案的成本与约束清单。

say.text: 以 @fde 现有的信息包为准,比较方案并给出推荐。
say.note: 复用当前范围,不重新开始调研。

howto.what_en: Compares feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommends a path with costs, constraints and evidence. For architecture or delivery decisions, not implementation.
howto.when_en: Use for an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation. When called by @fde, it reuses that run's current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Compare three feasible approaches and recommend a path with costs.
say_en.note: Follows the method reference and gives a recommendation.

say_en.text: Lay out this delivery decision as options with costs and limits.
say_en.note: Produces a cost and constraint list per option.

say_en.text: Use the @fde packet as-is and recommend a path.
say_en.note: Reuses the current scope instead of restarting discovery.
